name: inspira-animated-testimonials

frames.best_why: Frame 6 has portrait, name, role and the complete quote settled, with the cursor clear of the panel.

tagline: A tilted portrait deck beside a quote that sharpens in word by word.
summary: One customer testimonial at a time: a stack of slightly rotated portrait photos on the left, and on the right a name, job title, quote and two round arrow buttons that cycle to the next person.
appearance: On a dark panel, a square portrait sits at a slight angle with two faint copies fanned behind it. To the right, a bold name, a small grey role line, a few lines of quote text, and two small circular arrow buttons at the lower left of that column.
behaviour: Pressing an arrow swaps the photo with a small lift and settles the new portrait upright, while the quote disappears and its words blur back in one after another. With autoplay on it advances on a timer.
demo_content: Portraits of Sarah Chen, Marcus Johnson and Priya Patel, each with a quote praising a component library.
search_phrases: quote with a photo and next arrows
social proof with name and job title
wall of love entry with a headshot
rotating customer quotes for a landing page
use_when: A landing page should show one strong customer quote with a portrait and simple forward and back arrows.
avoid_when: Autoplay advances every four seconds, which is short for reading a full paragraph.
customise: Feed entries with quote, name, designation and image; autoplay and duration set the cycling, while the photo rotations and layout are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Three portrait images and one active slide with short blur and lift animations.

a11y.note: Both arrows are real buttons with aria-labels and photos carry alt text, but nothing checks reduced-motion.

issues: Frames 2 to 4 are caught mid-swap with the name and quote faded out, leaving an empty right column.
The quote and role text are mid grey on near-black, so they read weakly.
polish_why: Photo deck and blur-in quote are considered; low-contrast text and blank frames pull it down.
title: Animated Testimonials
